policies.blackout: Hard silence overrides all speech, effects, music and ambience inside intentional blackout intervals.
policies.typing: No repeated typing chirps or keyboard loops.
policies.notifications: One sound/speech for an incoming message, even when its notification preview and bubble are both shown.
policies.ambience: Opt in only for an established environment; no automatic random rain, office or station layer.
policies.loudness: Starting gains are editorial suggestions, not listening approval. Speech stays dominant.
policies.coverage: Core phone/UI, transition, error/battery, bounded glitch, soft reveal, aura impact, rain/office/cafe/station ambience. Not a universal Foley library.
